title: Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode

entities.name: Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE
entities.description: Information element included by the network in NB-S1 mode to negotiate DRX parameters.

entities.name: DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE
entities.description: Information element that the UE includes in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to indicate DRX parameters in NB-S1 mode.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to request tracking area update procedures.

entities.name: UE includes DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE
entities.description: Condition where the UE has included the DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

relations.description: The TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message may contain the DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE.
The network includes the Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE only if the UE has included the DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE.
